findings.summary: Dev-note input_commit invariant still violated (spec §5 footnote, same class as prior REJECT finding 2). The note records input_commit `d365557d34b0b7bb2b2a199a19775530a55c60cc` (this attempt's dispatch input_commit), but the actual final delivery/subject commit verified by the deterministic seal is `c83a9c316bf23322e50bc648cdb53da6e53d5562`. Spec §5 footnote is explicit: "input_commit 必须等于最终交付 commit；中途 rework 则 note 必须同步更新." The implementer's rework rationale (recording the dispatch input_commit rather than the delivery commit) does not satisfy this invariant — the gate (per footnote and prior review precedent) checks that the note's input_commit equals the final delivery commit. All product code (R1–R6), the mutation matrix (R8 attribution), non-goals (§4), and the dev-note path fix (prior finding 1) are correct and complete; only this evidence invariant remains.
